$readme: Approval stamps for everything published about James. Written by `npm run approve`, never by hand. A stamp binds a file path to the sha of its exact text; an edit breaks the stamp and the item is held offline until re-stamped. With requireApproval true, unapproved collection items (experience, projects, briefs, writing) are dropped at build and unapproved structural files (hero.js, data slices, about.mdx, personal.mdx) fail the build. See docs/copy-deck.md for the review queue.
